154:      (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L) (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)

190:variable (C) in
191:/-- **The honesty hypothesis: `μ` is a plus unit on every affine piece of the test.**
192:
193:This is the one thing the producer needs of `μ`, and it is a genuine hypothesis rather than a
194:restatement: a plus class over `Spec A` is `PicEtAff.mk E x` for an étale cover `E`, and

197:

199:over an affine test it is the single condition that `μ` is in the range of `relPicToPicEt`. -/
200:def IsPlusHonest (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (μ : picEt C T) : Prop :=
201:  ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens, ∃ z : relPic C (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1)),
202:    relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1)) z
203:      = picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) μ
204:
205:omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] in
206:variable (C) in
207:/-- Honesty is closed under multiplication — the range of `relPicToPicEt` is a subgroup, and
208:`picEtMap` is a homomorphism. -/
209:theorem IsPlusHonest.mul {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {μ ν : picEt C T}
210:    (hμ : IsPlusHonest C T μ) (hν : IsPlusHonest C T ν) :
211:    IsPlusHonest C T (μ * ν) := by
212:  intro U
213:  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hμ U
214:  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hν U
215:  exact ⟨z * w, by rw [map_mul, hz, hw, map_mul]⟩
216:
217:omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] in
218:variable (C) in
219:/-- Honesty is closed under inversion. -/
220:theorem IsPlusHonest.inv {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {μ : picEt C T}
221:    (hμ : IsPlusHonest C T μ) :
222:    IsPlusHonest C T μ⁻¹ := by
223:  intro U
224:  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hμ U
225:  exact ⟨z⁻¹, by rw [map_inv, hz, map_inv]⟩
226:
227:omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] in
228:variable (C) in
229:/-- Honesty is closed under powers. -/
230:theorem IsPlusHonest.pow {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {μ : picEt C T}
231:    (hμ : IsPlusHonest C T μ) (m : ℕ) :
232:    IsPlusHonest C T (μ ^ m) := by
233:  intro U
234:  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hμ U
235:  exact ⟨z ^ m, by rw [map_pow, hz, map_pow]⟩

241:says its affine collapse is the plus unit of the base-changed base class.  So a θ-family is in the
242:range of the unit on every affine piece, with no hypothesis on the curve.
243:
244:This is why `chartTwist` preserves honesty: two of its three factors are θ-families. -/
245:theorem thetaFamily_isPlusHonest (L₀ : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic)
246:    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
247:    IsPlusHonest C T (thetaFamily C L₀ T) := by
248:  intro U
249:  refine ⟨relPicAlgMap C (Algebra.ofId k Γ(T.left, U.1)) (relPicMk C (overSpec k k) L₀), ?_⟩
250:  rw [thetaFamily_natural]
251:  exact (picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1)).injective (by
252:    rw [picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt, thetaFamily_overSpec_affineEquiv])

255:/-- A Σ-family is honest: it *is* a θ-family (`sigmaFamily` is defined as one). -/
256:theorem sigmaFamily_isPlusHonest (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
257:    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
258:    IsPlusHonest C T (sigmaFamily C Z T) :=
259:  thetaFamily_isPlusHonest C _ T

262:/-- **THE ABEL VALUE IS HONEST AT EVERY TEST** — the witness that carries weight, and the one this
263:file's header cited by name before it existed (see the header's own retraction).
264:
265:The θ- and Σ-family witnesses above are the *twist factors*, which `chartTwist_isPlusHonest`
266:discharges anyway; they say nothing about the class being charted.  Since
267:`chartValue = abelDiv · Σ · (θᵐ)⁻¹` and honesty is a subgroup condition, honesty of a **chart
268:value** reduces to honesty of `abelDiv` — so this is the row that makes CHART-U(b) unconditional

270:
271:It is cheap for a structural reason: `abelDiv`'s components are `abelDivPlus`, i.e. `PicEtAff.unit`

273:`relPicMap` — so the witness on the piece `U` is the class of the *restricted* family, and
274:`abelDiv_val` plus `picEtMap_abelDiv` line the two up. -/
275:theorem abelDiv_isPlusHonest {n : ℕ} (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
276:    (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
277:    IsPlusHonest C T (abelDiv C π n T s) := by
278:  intro U
279:  refine ⟨relPicMk C (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1))
280:    ((divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n Γ(T.left, U.1)
281:      (divFamZar.map C π n (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) s)).picClass), ?_⟩
282:  rw [picEtMap_abelDiv, abelDiv_overSpec]
283:  rfl

286:/-- **`chartTwist` PRESERVES honesty** — the reason the producer reaches the Σ-chart.
287:
288:`chartTwist λ = λ · θᵐ · Σ⁻¹`, and both twist factors are θ-families, hence honest at every test
289:with no hypothesis.  Since honesty is a subgroup condition, the twisted class is honest exactly
290:when `λ` is.
291:
292:So the residue of CHART-U(b) is **the λ-factor alone**: no twist bookkeeping enters, which is the
293:mis-pricing the §3.3 correction 5 records. -/
294:theorem chartTwist_isPlusHonest (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
295:    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) {lam : picEt C T} (hlam : IsPlusHonest C T lam) :
296:    IsPlusHonest C T (chartTwist C m Z T lam) := by
297:  rw [chartTwist]
298:  exact (hlam.mul C ((thetaFamily_isPlusHonest C (thetaCechClass C) T).pow C m)).mul C
299:    ((sigmaFamily_isPlusHonest C Z T).inv C)

303:set_option linter.overlappingInstances false in

308:`isOpen_chartLocus_of_plusFibre` needs a per-piece datum with the plus-class property;

313:
314:`IsAffineHom π` follows from `IsFinite π`, whence the disabled overlapping-instance linter — the
315:same configuration `chartLocusAffineLocal_of_plusFibre` carries and for the same reason. -/
316:theorem isOpen_chartLocus_of_isPlusHonest
317:    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
318:    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)

322:    exists_isChartDatumPlusFibre_of_mem_range C π _
323:      (by
324:        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := chartTwist_isPlusHonest C m Z T hlam U
325:        exact ⟨z, hz.trans (picEtMap_chartTwist m Z (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) lam)⟩)

329:/-- **The chart locus as an OPEN OF THE TEST, from honesty alone** — the shape the `W` field of a
330:chart datum consumes (`chartLocusOpens`, `Picard/Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean:115`), with its `haff`
331:argument discharged rather than passed through.
332:
333:This is c9b's clause (i) paid in full for an honest class: not "reduced to", but produced. -/
334:def chartLocusOpensOfIsPlusHonest
335:    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
336:    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
337:    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T) (hlam : IsPlusHonest C T lam) :
338:    T.left.Opens where
339:  carrier := chartLocus C m Z lam
340:  is_open' := isOpen_chartLocus_of_isPlusHonest C π hπ m Z T lam hlam
341:
342:@[simp]
343:lemma mem_chartLocusOpensOfIsPlusHonest
344:    {hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom}
345:    {m : ℕ} {Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor}
346:    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T} {hlam : IsPlusHonest C T lam}
347:    {t : T.left} :
348:    t ∈ chartLocusOpensOfIsPlusHonest C π hπ m Z T lam hlam ↔ t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam :=

101:/-- **The (C2) effectivity theorem** (recon §0.3; Kleiman `th:cmp` Part 2, the descent
102:of the rigidified pair): for a module-finite faithfully flat cover `A → B` of the test
103:algebra of a curve point `σ`, every Čech Picard class on the cover curve `X_B` that is
104:rigidified along the base-changed section (`hrig`) and has equal coprojection pullbacks
105:on the curve over `B ⊗[A] B` (`hdesc`) descends along the cover inclusion:
106:`∃ M, cg^* M = L`. -/
107:theorem exists_cechPic_map_whiskerLeft_eq [Module.Finite A B]
108:    (L : (XB).CechPic)
109:    (hrig : Over.IsRigidified
110:      (Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A B).restrictScalars k) ≫ σ) L)
111:    (hdesc : Scheme.CechPic.map (u₁) L = Scheme.CechPic.map (u₂) L) :
112:    ∃ M : (XA).CechPic, Scheme.CechPic.map (cg) M = L := by
113:  induction L using Scheme.CechPic.ind with | _ 𝒩 a
114:  induction a using Quot.ind with | _ γ
115:  rw [show (Quot.mk _ γ : (XB).unitsH1 𝒩)
116:    = CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups.OneCocycle.class γ from rfl] at hrig hdesc ⊢
117:  refine exists_cechPic_map_whiskerLeft_eq_of_pieces C σ 𝒩 γ hrig hdesc fun x => ?_
118:  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, h1⟩ := Over.exists_isAffineOpen_cechPicMap_preimage_eq_one
119:    (B := B) C (Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒩 γ.class) x
120:  exact ⟨V, hV, hxV, Over.pieceTrivialization_of_cechPicMap_eq_one C V h1⟩
121:
122:end Over
123:
124:end effectivity
125:
126:/-! ## The surjectivity close (recon §0.2) -/
127:
128:section close
129:
130:variable (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
131:
132:/-- **Surjectivity of the unit of the étale plus construction over a section-admitting
133:field test** (Kleiman 2.5(2), axiom (C2) — the campaign headline): if the curve admits
134:a `K`-point `σ`, every class of `PicEtAff C K` comes from a relative Picard class.
135:
136:A representative on an étale cover of `Spec K` is refined to a finite separable field
137:extension (field cofinality); the rigidification layer produces a rigidified Čech
138:representative whose descent equation holds on the nose; the (C2) effectivity theorem
139:descends it along the cover inclusion; and the `relPicMk`/`mk`-calculus identifies the
140:descended class's unit with the original plus class. -/
141:theorem PicEtAff.unit_surjective_of_section (σ : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
142:    Function.Surjective (PicEtAff.unit C K) := by
143:  intro q
144:  induction q using PicEtAff.ind with | _ E x
145:  classical
146:  -- ### refine the representing cover to a finite separable field extension
147:  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hLalg, hLfin, hLsep, ⟨f⟩⟩ :=
148:    E.exists_finiteSeparableField_algHom
149:  set F : Algebra.EtaleCover K := Algebra.EtaleCover.ofField (K := K) L with hF
150:  set g : E.Carrier →ₐ[K] F.Carrier :=
151:    ((Algebra.EtaleCover.ofFieldEquiv (K := K) L).symm.toAlgHom).comp f with hg
152:  set y : descentClasses C F := descentMap C g x with hy
153:  have hq : PicEtAff.mk C E x = PicEtAff.mk C F y :=
154:    (PicEtAff.mk_descentMap C g x).symm
155:  haveI : Module.Finite K F.Carrier :=
156:    Module.Finite.equiv (R := K) (M := L)
157:      (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofFieldEquiv (K := K) L).symm.toLinearEquiv
158:  -- ### a rigidified representative of the descent class (G1)
159:  obtain ⟨Lc, hrig, hLcrep⟩ := relPic.exists_isRigidified_rep
160:    (Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId K F.Carrier).restrictScalars k) ≫ σ)
161:    (y : relPic C (overSpec k F.Carrier))
162:  have hmem : relPicMk C (overSpec k F.Carrier) Lc ∈ descentClasses C F := by
163:    rw [hLcrep]
164:    exact y.2
165:  -- ### the on-the-nose descent equation (the rigidified transport keystone)
166:  have hdesc0 := Over.IsRigidified.cechPicMap_doubleInl_eq_doubleInr σ hmem hrig
167:  have hinl : doubleInl (k := k) F = tensorInl (k := k) (A := K) (B := F.Carrier) :=
168:    AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl
169:  have hinr : doubleInr (k := k) F = tensorInr (k := k) (A := K) (B := F.Carrier) :=
170:    AlgHom.ext fun _ => rfl
171:  rw [hinl, hinr] at hdesc0
172:  -- ### the effectivity theorem
173:  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Over.exists_cechPic_map_whiskerLeft_eq C σ Lc hrig hdesc0
174:  refine ⟨relPicMk C (overSpec k K) M, ?_⟩
175:  -- ### the `mk`-calculus close
176:  rw [PicEtAff.unit_eq_mk C F (relPicMk C (overSpec k K) M)]
177:  rw [hq]
178:  refine congrArg (PicEtAff.mk C F) (Subtype.ext ?_)
179:  change relPicAlgMap C ((Algebra.ofId K F.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
180:      (relPicMk C (overSpec k K) M) = (y : relPic C (overSpec k F.Carrier))
181:  rw [relPicAlgMap, relPicMap_mk, hM, hLcrep]
182:
183:/-- **The unit of the étale plus construction is an isomorphism over a
184:section-admitting field test** — étale separatedness (C1) plus effectivity (C2):
185:`relPic C (Spec K) ≃* PicEtAff C K`. -/
186:noncomputable def PicEtAff.unitEquiv_of_section (σ : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
187:    relPic C (overSpec k K) ≃* PicEtAff C K :=
188:  MulEquiv.ofBijective (PicEtAff.unit C K)
189:    ⟨PicEtAff.unit_injective C K, PicEtAff.unit_surjective_of_section C K σ⟩
190:
191:end close

193:end AlgebraicGeometry

105:/-- **THE B-5 PACKAGING**: `ChartsCoverLocally` from pointwise coverage.
106:
107:The hypothesis is exactly the shape the coverage geometry delivers, and is worth reading
108:field by field against `w4-datb` §1.2.  For every test `T`, every degree-zero class `s` on
109:it, and every point `t` of `T`:
110:
111:* `W` — an open neighbourhood of `t`.  In the intended instantiation this is
112:  `chartLocusOpens` (`Pic0ChartUnivReduce.lean`), whose openness is CHART-U(b) and is
113:  unconditional since `IsSplitWitnessIsoInvariant` was discharged;
114:* `i` — the chart index, chosen *at `t`*.  Per-point by construction, which is what the
115:  I-0204 non-uniformity of the twist exponent `m` requires;
116:* `x` — a point of the `i`-th chart scheme over `W`, i.e. the divisor family the coverage
117:  argument produces at the splitting field of `κ(t)`;
118:* `hx` — that its class is `s` restricted to `W`.
119:
120:Given that, the sieve condition holds.  So a coverage lane never has to mention `Sigma.desc`,
121:a coproduct of yoneda presheaves, a covering sieve, or a Grothendieck topology: it produces

30:`IsChartDatumPlusFibre C π μ D` compares `μ`'s fibre at `κ(t)`, read as a plus class, with the
31:plus-*unit* of `D`'s fibre class.  So the natural hypothesis on `μ` is that it is *already* a

41:* not vacuous, and this is the payoff — the range of `relPicToPicEt` is a **subgroup**, and every
42:  class the chart layer twists by is in it: the θ-family (`thetaFamily_isPlusHonest`), the
